criteria.scenario: Happy path works from the real user-facing surface.
command: set -euo pipefail; URL=$(gcloud run services describe desk-portal-api --project fir-lms-prod --region asia-northeast3 --format="value(status.url)"); curl --fail --silent --show-error "$URL/health"; printf "\n"; gcloud run services describe desk-portal-api --project fir-lms-prod --region asia-northeast3 --format="value(status.latestReadyRevisionName,spec.template.spec.serviceAccountName,status.traffic[0].percent)"

criteria.scenario: Riskiest edge or failure path is handled.
command: set -euo pipefail; URL=$(gcloud run services describe desk-portal-api --project fir-lms-prod --region asia-northeast3 --format="value(status.url)"); test "$(curl --silent --output /tmp/desk-api-unauth.json --write-out "%{http_code}" "$URL/v1/me")" = "401"; rg -q "authentication_required" /tmp/desk-api-unauth.json; test "$(curl --silent --output /tmp/desk-api-origin.json --write-out "%{http_code}" -H "Origin: https://example.com" "$URL/health")" = "403"; rg -q "origin_not_allowed" /tmp/desk-api-origin.json; printf "unauth=401 origin=403\n"
